notes: Judged concerns: C3-C8, C11, C12, C14, C16 (C1, C2, C15 novelty and C9, C10, C13 presentation excluded). The text given is arXiv v1, while the referees reviewed a later revision that added a theory section (quantum-metric maps, calculated pair correlation vs U in Fig. 4g, red line in Fig. 4d rather than 5d). C11 and C12 refer to that theory section, which does not exist in v1, so neither review could raise them; no referee fix appears in v1, so fixed_in_v1 is false for all. Review B matches most data-analysis concerns directly (C4, C5, C6, C7, C14, C3) and partly C8 and C16; it never states the 50 meV vs 1700 m/s contradiction outright. B's 2.10(c) comparison of the Tc maximum with MATTG/ATMG overlaps novelty concern C1, and its N-2 band-counting minor point matches presentation concern C13, so neither is listed as extra. Review A is a lookalike/practice-check format focused on device selection, inhomogeneity and switching-current artifacts; it partly touches C3, C4 and C14 and misses the stiffness-baseline and velocity concerns (C5-C8). Both reviews add many substantive points not raised by referees (A: BKT universal-relation stiffness mismatch, Josephson-network switching; B: Delta/kTc contradiction, Fig. 4f nonequilibrium, fan indexing).
